pages.title: Turing Morphogen
pages.text: A pair of chemicals, one that activates and diffuses slowly and one that inhibits and diffuses fast. Mixed on a dish they paint stripes and spots by themselves, exactly the reaction-diffusion patterns Turing predicted in 1952.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Turing proposed that patterns in animals arise from reaction and diffusion. I extracted the morphogens from a minimal cell, set their handedness with a chiral crystal and tuned their rates using the complex plane. Spots appeared on the dish.
